visualCharacteristics.purpose: Modellreihen-Kacheln: Fahrzeugbild, Titel, Modellanzahl als Link zur Modellreihen-Seite
visualCharacteristics.interaction: whole tile clickable via the count link (stretched link), decorative chevron
visualCharacteristics.badge: charging icon (aria-label Elektromodell) when electric is true

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image (+ alt); cell 2: richtext h2 title + paragraph with count link; cell 3: electric boolean

reuseGuidance: Use for carline/category tiles that each link to one detail page; for model tiles with price and CTAs use cards-model.
